# the contributor audit: critical first variations, affine cap budgets, and eight fibers


a general OC proof.

## 1. Proper critical cuts and the four-facet theorem: PASS

I read `candidate 09527acafbefa083`
through Section 7. The first derivative retains the original discrete
sum and the fixed through-source condition. At proper cuts the section
area is positive and continuous, so Fubini gives the displayed derivative
with the correct sign and the factor `1/|u|`. Its vanishing equates the
two endpoint section areas. Positive-volume captured-side BM equality
maps the artificial bottom facets by the same positive homothety; in
d>=2 their equal positive areas force ratio one. The d=1 exception is
correctly explicit.

The two whole-edge constraints in the specified four-facet combinatorics
are independent of the individual integer tilts. Their displayed kernel
is exactly the two-dimensional space of translations, as direct
substitution in all four support numbers verifies. This conclusion
depends on which complete original edges the caps contain. It cannot
be transferred to the different truncated-triangle cap pattern.

For the continuous-normal derivative, slicing along the original normal
gives a bounded difference quotient on a bounded projection. The proper
section's relative boundary is null, and every relative interior point
of that section lies in the body's interior. Dominated convergence
therefore applies without smoothness. Equality of cap sets and their
translated facets gives equal section areas and the midpoint centroid
identity, hence the source is the middle section centroid. It does not
make it the volume centroid of the whole middle fiber.

The second-variation statement explicitly requires polytopes and cuts
containing no vertices. Under those conditions every facet meeting the
section continues into the common captured cap, while the remaining
facets have uniform positive slack there. Thus the translated fibers
have a common section neighborhood. The allowed shear aligns those
caps without altering integer bases or fiber volume. The resulting
three copies of F at opposite thresholds have the asserted block
diagonal Hessian. This is a necessary local test only; global criticality
does not follow from that Hessian.

## 2. Affine homothetic captured-root budgets: PASS

I read `candidate ad88f967d6335089` through
the complete first-variation section. The direct section-continuity
proof uses homothetic inclusions on both sides of an interior level,
so differentiability of the cap volume is justified without assuming
a smooth fiber. Homothetic caps have section weights proportional to
their roots to the power d-1; the exact finite weighted base barycenter
follows. Strictly positive weights also correctly force the source
base into the relative interior of the finite convex hull.

Multiplying the weighted barycenter by the affine root slope proves
`B=a0 sum a^(d-1)`. The stated polynomial Bregman identity is exact;
its linear terms vanish after summation, yielding the nonnegative
deficit `N a0^d-B` and its equality characterization. Positive definite
Hessian on the effective base span gives uniqueness of the formal
affine-root minimizer. This is not silently identified with actual
tilt evolution.

For d=2, writing roots about the arithmetic base mean gives
`Sigma ell=alpha(z0-barz)`. The covariance formula, the singleton
convention, and the exact positivity condition on consecutive bases
follow directly. For eight fibers, source3 has squared Mahalanobis
distance1/21, yielding `8(4/9)/(1+1/21)=112/33` exactly.

The whole-fiber root inequality is Jensen with these SAME positive
section weights and the actual convex body. It bounds a first moment
of the expansion ratio and makes no unsupported higher-moment claim.
The cone-persistence assumption is sufficient for the displayed actual
tilt polynomial. It is an additional hypothesis, as the two explicit
planar fibers with identical captured triangular caps but different
quadratic tilt responses demonstrate. The full shape derivative also
has the correct fixed-source constraint; affine cap translations make
the section centroid affine and allow the stated weighted cancellation.

## 3. Eight-triangle exact depth and menu: PASS

I read `candidate d4522420ea2ebef1`
and reran `supporting computation verify_triangle_eight_depth_exact_certificate.py`. The exact
verifier passes all 35 cells, the exceptional sum-of-squares identity,
42 rational triangles, 420 rational Bernstein coefficients, strict
interior positivity, and both endpoint tables.

The normalized triangle projections exhaust every nonzero continuous
normal. Pairing the seven symmetric base terms correctly excludes
negative tilt at equality. The direct purely integer bound includes
the whole boundary fiber. The exceptional polynomial identity is
obtained using `sum k=4`, `sum k^2=44`, and is strictly positive in
the open projection-parameter strip. On the other cells, nonnegative
Bernstein coefficients and the listed vertex/edge strictness prove
strict positivity also on internal subdivision boundaries. Thus the
finite certificate proves both the all-normal bound and its equality
classification, not just nonnegativity on sampled directions.

The endpoint t=-1 table has its unique global minimum at L=2/11;
the opposite canonical endpoint stays above it. Moving a cap boundary
from the centroid to a noncentroid middle point with a larger chosen
barycentric coordinate reduces its source mass strictly, so only the
two asserted middle centroids maximize depth. Caps containing such a
centroid strictly cannot be additional equality caps, because their
parallel through-point subcap has strictly less source-fiber volume.

For the natural six-cap cover, the residual obstacles, unique constant
optimum, and unique nearest-neighbor multipliers all check by reflection,
strict convexity, and the original stationarity recurrence. Substitution
verifies the row weights5/32 and3/32 and their source barycenter. Strict
concavity of `sqrt(1-a(z)^2)` applies throughout the full base interval,
so Jensen holds for all three caps in the proved complete critical menu.

The companion `candidate 0f873637705b2427`
has the correct exact sums and its rational cap bound is below the
claimed step depth for every integer m>=4. Symmetries and convex ambient
depth regions justify the global upper-bound interpretation. Its
general step-cover KKT and Green formulas are valid as program identities;
it explicitly avoids claiming those covers remain critical after the
depth formula fails. None of these finite chain results proves OC in
arbitrary dimensions or for arbitrary bodies.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
